modelNotes: Assists Board 1.0 uses season assists, last 5 assists, last 10 assists, expected minutes, minutes confidence, usage, position role, and recent assist trend.
Assists Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent assist rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Cunningham (knee) is probable to play Sunday in Atlanta.
injury.detail: Cunningham is dealing with some minor soreness in his right knee, but he's planning to play through it. Cunningham is averaging 25.6 points, 5.1 rebounds, 7.9 assists, 2.0 triples, 1.4 steals and 0.9 blocks per game this season.

injury.shortComment: Antetokounmpo (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Oklahoma City, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
injury.detail: Antetokounmpo previously dealt with a wrist injury in November, and he's now working through a groin issue that puts his status for Sunday's game up in the air. He has yet to miss a game this season, but if he's not cleared to play against Oklahoma City, then Andrew Wiggins and Bobby Portis would be the top candidates to enter Miami's starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Tatum (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings.
injury.detail: Tatum will be rested for the first leg of the Celtics' back-to-back set, so he should be back on the floor for Sunday's game against the Warriors. With both Tatum and Derrick White (shoulder) sidelined, the Celtics will rely more heavily on Paul George, Payton Pritchard, Baylor Scheierman, Hugo Gonzalez and Sam Hauser to carry the scoring load against Sacramento.

injury.shortComment: Towns (illness) won't play in Saturday's game versus the Trail Blazers.
injury.detail: Towns was initially listed as questionable. However, he has since been ruled out, marking his first absence of the 2026-27 campaign. Towns' next opportunity to play will come Sunday against Indiana. In the meantime, Andre Drummond is in line to start.

injury.shortComment: Gilgeous-Alexander (back/neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus Miami.
injury.detail: After scoring 40 points in Friday's 126-120 win over the Pelicans, Gilgeous-Alexander could miss his first game of the 2026-27 campaign due to back and neck issues. With Nikola Topic (hip), Alex Caruso (hip) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) all unavailable, Bennett Stirtz may be needed in the starting lineup if Gilgeous-Alexander is ruled out Sunday.

injury.shortComment: White (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Sacramento.
injury.detail: White drew the questionable tag for Saturday's game due to left AC joint sprain in his shoulder. The veteran guard will be in street clothes for the first leg of the Celtics' back-to-back set, but he could make his return Sunday against the Warriors. With Jayson Tatum (rest) also out, Payton Pritchard and Paul George will carry the workload for the Celtics, and there will be more opportunities for the likes of Sam Hauser, Hugo Gonzalez, Baylor Scheierman and Jordan Walsh.

injury.shortComment: Siakam (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against New York.
injury.detail: Siakam has only missed one game this season, but he's in danger of sitting out Sunday due to left hip soreness. If the 32-year-old can't suit up versus the Knicks, Obi Toppin may move into the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Smith (illness) has been upgraded to probable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets.
injury.detail: Smith was initially listed as questionable but is now expected to return from a one-game absence due to an illness. Over his last five appearances, the big man has averaged 17.2 points, 8.2 rebounds, 2.8 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.2 blocks across 28.2 minutes per showing. He could also see a slight bump in minutes if Nic Claxton (illness) is ruled out.

injury.shortComment: Anunoby (calf) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Trail Blazers.
injury.detail: Anunoby will miss his first game of the 2026-27 regular season due to left calf tightness, although he could be back on the floor for the second leg of the Knicks' back-to-back set against the Pacers on Sunday. Landry Shamet and Miles McBride are both in line for elevated roles in Anunoby's absence.

injury.shortComment: Washington (illness/shoulder) is listed as out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Washington was initially listed on the injury report due to a shoulder issue. Since then, he developed an illness and was downgraded to doubtful. Washington will now miss his first game of the 2026-27 campaign, with his next opportunity to play coming Sunday in Utah. In the meantime, Naji Marshall and Zaccharie Risacher are candidates for more minutes.

injury.shortComment: Claxton (illness) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Nuggets.
injury.detail: After missing the first eight outings of the 2026-27 campaign due to a hamstring injury, Claxton has suited up in six of the last seven games for Chicago. However, he's now dealing with an illness that will leave his status for Sunday up in the air. If Claxton doesn't play, expect Zach Collins and Noa Essengue to earn more minutes off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Williams is probable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets due to a left thumb sprain.
injury.detail: Williams is dealing with a sprained thumb on his non-shooting hand, but he's expected to play through it. Williams is averaging 6.9 points and 1.9 assists per game this season.

injury.shortComment: Gardner (hamstring) is probable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.
injury.detail: The probable tag suggests Gardner is on the verge of returning to the hardwood after a one-game absence due to injury. He's been in and out of the starting five, but he started his last three games before missing Wednesday's win over the Bucks. He's averaging 3.0 points, 2.3 rebounds and 1.1 assists per game this season, so even if he's cleared to play Sunday, he shouldn't carry a ton of fantasy appeal.

injury.shortComment: Robinson (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
injury.detail: Robinson is under the weather and will not play in the front end of Boston's back-to-back set, but he could be available for Sunday night's game against the Warriors. With Robinson sidelined, Luka Garza and Chris Cenac should both see a bump in minutes behind starting center Neemias Queta.

injury.shortComment: Clarkson (foot) won't play in Saturday's game against Portland.
injury.detail: Clarkson is battling a case of plantar fasciitis in his right foot, so he will miss a second consecutive contest. Without Clarkson on the floor, Landry Shamet is in line for more playing time.

injury.shortComment: Ayton (illness) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against Orlando.
injury.detail: Ayton played 11 minutes during Friday's 98-94 win over Chicago, but he appears to have picked up some sort of illness over the weekend. If he can't play Sunday, expect Khris Middleton and Bilal Coulibaly to see increased burn off the Wizards' bench.

injury.shortComment: Lawal (groin) is out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Lawal will miss a second straight game with right groin tightness. The rookie forward isn't expected to have a big role in the rotation, so he likely won't have much fantasy upside anytime soon. His next chance to play will come Sunday against the Jazz on the second leg of a back-to-back set.
